import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_30/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_30/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join on 'movieId'
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="movieId", how="inner")

# Reorder columns to match target schema:
# ['movieId': int, 'title': str, 'genres': str, 'userId': int, 'tag': str, 'timestamp': int]
df_result = df_joined[['movieId', 'title', 'genres', 'userId', 'tag', 'timestamp']]

# Ensure correct dtypes
df_result['movieId'] = df_result['movieId'].astype(int)
df_result['userId'] = df_result['userId'].astype(int)
df_result['timestamp'] = df_result['timestamp'].astype(int)
df_result['title'] = df_result['title'].astype(str)
df_result['genres'] = df_result['genres'].astype(str)
df_result['tag'] = df_result['tag'].astype(str)

# Write to target path without index
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_30/target_multisource.csv"
df_result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
